analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($627.36) vs SMA5 ($650.12)/SMA20 ($679.48)/SMA50 ($711.26): indicating short- to mid-term trend below moving averages.
· Position relative to SMA100 ($710.46)/SMA200 ($682.17): suggesting a weak long-term trend.
· 52-week position (34.6%) + current price level near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (42.8 → 30.0): entering oversold territory, strengthening downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.1002 → -3.5682): continuing weakness, reinforcing the downtrend.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Lower Band $627.55): approaching the lower band, suggesting potential for further decline.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($610.15): support based on the 20-day low.
· Swing Resistance ($629.21): resistance based on the 5-day high, a break above could signal a short-term bounce.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern: 5-day and 20-day lows are identical, confirming a sideways pattern.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.78x): contracted volume, reducing confidence in the price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis: downtrend continues; although oversold, no trend reversal signal confirmed, maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
